discrepancies: Status split mismatch: page 1 says 89 Verified / 61 Check, but the 150 catalog rows are 95 Verified / 55 Check (45 carton + 10 box). The sum 150 is correct; the split is off by 6 SKUs in each direction and cannot be derived from the rows.

Corrections wording ambiguity: '14 Duplicate Rows Purged (-20 Phantom Units)' and 'prior summary 1-unit drift (298 -> 297)' describe different stages; they conflict only if one assumes the 298 already excluded the phantom units. The document never states the pre-purge totals, so -20 is not independently verifiable, but there is no arithmetic contradiction under the staged reading.

Unresolved possible duplicate: page 11 checklist flags #39 Krohler KRG-3730-COMB-NF-G and #40 Krohler KRG370combi NFG as possibly the same barcode. Merging them as the checklist states ('1 SKU (2 units)') would produce 149 SKUs / 297 units — units stay 297 because both physical units are retained; only the row count falls.
Page 1 states '0 duplicate rows' while page 11 flags a possible duplicate pair; not a current numeric contradiction, but the duplicate status is not fully resolved.

Audit limitation: this model cannot visually render PNG images. Page images were verified via local Windows OCR instead. OCR confirmed the page 1 summary figures, the printed ledger equation, the 89/61 printed split, the 14-duplicate/-20 and 298->297 wording, and the page 11 grand total of 150 SKUs / 297 units. OCR independently confirmed 55 Check status tokens but missed 6 Verified tokens across pages 3, 4, 5, 8, 9 and 10, so the row-level 95 Verified count relies on the extracted text parse (which is internally consistent and matches every other total).
